method: Combine measured defect maps with conservative local tests. Store confidence and correction masks. Do not replace every isolated bright pixel, because real highlights may be sparse. Apply corrections in a declared source domain and retain the unmodified original.
fixture: A measured hot pixel adjacent to a real small moving specular highlight.
oracle: The persistent defect is corrected while the moving highlight is preserved and corrections remain inspectable.
mutant: Remove every isolated bright pixel using one intensity threshold.
